newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-INDIA GDRS LAG FIRM BOMBAY, TAIWAN DOWN.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-INDIA GDRS LAG FIRM BOMBAY, TAIWAN DOWN.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts failed to match gains in Bombay on Monday but traders said there were signs that sentiment was improving.
Blue chip Reliance Industries saw increased GDR demand, gaining 25 cents to $23.25/24.25, and ICICI added 85 cents to $16.50/17.50.
"The selling pressure is definitely easing the lower we get," commented one dealer.
The HSBC James Capel India GDR index JCEAI dipped 0.81 points, or 0.93 percent, to 85.74, a premium of 17.38 percent to the local market.
The Cazenove Indian GDR index, which measures changes from midday to midday, was down 0.09 points at 97.34 as Bombay's benchmark 30-share index rose 83.76 points to 4,481.30.
Taiwan GDRs tracked the weak home market, after electronic stocks took a hammering as investors switched to construction and steels plays.
The Capel Taiwan index was off 3.79 points, or 2.68 percent, at 137.61 -- representing a discount of 1.78 percent -- as electronics dragged the home market down 96.27 to 9,897.27.
The Capel Korea index finished up 1.36 points, or 1.78 percent, at 78.43, a premium of 42.02 percent.
